note: Teleop was calibrated on reference_base_orientation_wxyz. Only these physical reference mount orientations are stored; runtime J1 offsets are derived from the current scene geometry, independent of its name. Relative z-axis tilt above 0.01 deg requires recalibration. Calibration covers only the explicitly listed arm_base_links (verified 08-family base conventions); other arm models require recalibration. Missing arms receive zero offsets.

evidence: Teleop was calibrated on the original workstation vendor mounts rotated -90 / +105 deg about base z. configs/workcell/vendor_bench_overrides.json records the measured -84.10 / +85.85 deg mounts. Comparing scene orientations to these reference orientations derives J1 corrections (-5.90 / +19.15 deg for the measured-mount scene); tests/test_teleop_calibration.py verifies that corrected mapped commands preserve world poses.
